title: Large-Language-Model Discovery of Quantum LDPC Codes through Structured Concept Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2606.24808v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check codes promise low-overhead error correction, but high-performing constructions remain hard to find. Here we introduce structured concept evolution, in which a large language model (LLM) evolves construction programs and their internal search strategies by modifying the finite group, protograph shapes or entry-assignment rule. We search for codes with fewer than $600$ data qubits and check weight at most $12$, optimizing $kd^2/n$ or the circuit-level logical error rate. Our method improves on published lifted-product benchmarks in selected parameter regimes, with exactly certified distances for the leading results. Circuit-level optimization typically yields lower logical error rates than $kd^2/n$ optimization, often despite smaller code distances. With the same evolution framework and step budget, the best LLM outperforms all random-mutation and hill-climbing runs on both objectives. Our results

translated_title: 通过结构化概念演化的大语言模型发现量子LDPC码
translated_abstract: 量子低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码有望实现低开销的量子纠错，但高性能的构造方法仍然难以找到。本文提出了结构化概念演化方法，其中大语言模型（LLM）通过修改有限群、原型图形状或元素分配规则，来演化构造程序及其内部搜索策略。我们搜索数据量子比特少于600且校验权重不超过12的码，优化目标为 kd²/n 或电路级逻辑错误率。我们的方法在特定参数区间内超越了已发表的提升乘积（lifted-product）基准结果，且领先结果均具有精确认证的码距离。电路级优化通常比 kd²/n 优化产生更低的逻辑错误率，即便其码距离往往更小。在相同的演化框架和步数预算下，表现最佳的大语言模型在两个优化目标上都超越了所有随机变异和爬山法运行。我们的结果……
tldr: 该论文提出结构化概念演化方法，让大语言模型通过修改有限群、原型图等构造要素自主演化量子LDPC码的构造程序与搜索策略，在特定参数区间超越了已发表的基准结果，且最佳模型在两个优化目标上均优于随机变异和爬山法。
